lesson.concept: When the question is given in words, write the two equations first. Read one sentence at a time and translate each into an equation before solving anything.
lesson.why: This is one of the highest-frequency errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: x is the sum of 2 and y, and 5x = 6 - y
work: Only now solve. Substitute x from the first equation into the second.

probe.problem: x is 3 more than y, and 2x + y = 12.
probe.hint: See the example for the pattern.

learner_message: Write the two equations from the sentences first, one per sentence, before solving anything.
